speaker: Pedro Lara
title: Fine-Tuning Gemma for Fact Retrieval: A MeMo-Based Approach to Next-Gen RAG Systems
description: This presentation explores a practical, end-to-end implementation of the Memory Model (MeMo) architecture, offering a compelling approach for developers building advanced agentic pipelines or enhancing Large Language Model (LLM) memory beyond traditional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Attendees will be guided through a comprehensive Colab notebook demonstrating a dual-model framework that separates reasoning from factual recall. The session covers the complete technical pipeline—from automated fact extraction, semantic consolidation, and cross-document synthesis for multi-hop reasoning—to the final execution of a multi-turn inference loop orchestrating Gemini as the Executive model for question decomposition and synthesis, alongside a LoRA-fine-tuned Gemma via KerasHub acting as the parameterized Memory Model.

speaker: Aaron Guerrero Hernandez
title: Vibe Code with Gemini in Google AI Studio
description: ¡Vamos a aprender programando un juego! Crearemos juntos "Snake & Beats", un juego retro con estética neón y reproductor de música integrado. Utilizaremos Gemini en Google AI Studio para generar una aplicación de React completa en un solo archivo y te enseñaré cómo realizar el despliegue directo en Cloud Run para que tu proyecto esté disponible en la web.

speaker: Dinorah Tovar Duarte
title: On Private: Orchestrating Gemma 4 and AppFunctions on Android
description: Here is Dinorah, your trustable Android Developer that also loves security As Android evolves into an AI-first OS, the role of a health app is shifting from a passive data silo to an active, intelligent agent. But how do we build these "agentic" experiences without compromising the most sensitive data a user owns? This session explores the technical intersection of the new AppFunctions API and Gemma 4 (E2B/E4B) models. We will dive into architecting a system where on-device LLMs reason over Health Connect data locally via AICore, ensuring zero-cloud roundtrips. Keep you health private and secure
